judgment_calls.decision: Urgent for any patient who attempted/considered self-harm or suicide, as the box header says; no escalation to Very urgent/Emergency.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Very urgent for high risk (page only says 'Refer urgently').

judgment_calls.decision: Current attempt = 'Suicide attempt'/'Intentionally harming self' events; past-year acts = 'History of attempted suicide'/'History of deliberate self harm' situations with onset within 1 year.
judgment_calls.alternatives: 'Previous known suicide attempt' event, rejected because it descends from 'Suicide attempt' and would fire Q1.

judgment_calls.decision: Probable 'At low risk for suicide' only when Q1, Q2 and all four Q4 findings are explicitly recorded as No.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Omitting the low-risk rule; modelling the Q3 = No path (not expressible).

judgment_calls.decision: Q2 uses the 'Current' qualifier; Q3 uses onset within 1 month of the unqualified 'Thoughts of self harm'.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A single unqualified form for both (would make every considered patient high risk).
